decisions.choice: AI-drafted marker and edit diff live in client state and the offline-queue payload; no schema/block change
decisions.justification: BlockSchema is strict with no marker field (packages/validators/src/drafting.ts:79-124) and the issue lists no core/db change; immutable versions (service.ts:210-245) are the persisted diff

decisions.choice: Draft edits queue in a new encrypted draft-edits store beside the outbox rather than as a file item
decisions.justification: OutboxItem is a blob upload with presign/PUT states (apps/web/lib/pwa/outbox/db.ts:8-31); a JSON save does not fit that uploader, but crypto.ts and sync triggers (sync.ts) are reused

decisions.choice: Actions follow workspaceAction with dynamic core imports and action 'draft.write'
